epics.title: Frontend Build and Delivery Integration
epics.jtbd: When a real user opens the launched product, I want the backend to serve the built static UI output, so that the actual UI is visible rather than a bare API.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Increase the percentage of successful static UI loads from 0% to 100% on a fresh Docker deployment.
requirements: R1: The Docker image build process must execute 'npm ci && npm run build' within the frontend directory.
R2: The backend service must be configured to statically serve the compiled frontend assets from its route.

slices.title: Integrate Frontend Build into Docker and Backend Delivery
slices.jtbd: When implementing the Docker multi-stage build and Spring Boot static resource mapping for this epic, I want the frontend to be compiled and served automatically, so that the launched product displays the actual UI.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a fresh clone of the repository
When I run docker build and docker run
Then the container starts up and serves the compiled frontend HTML at the root URL.
Given the application is running
When I make a GET request to the root URL
Then it returns a 200 OK and serves index.html instead of a 404 or backend JSON response.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce manual frontend deployment steps from 2 to 0.

epics.title: Design Mockup Generation AI Model Fix
epics.jtbd: When the design generator runs, I want it to output an implementable HTML/CSS mockup, so that the design session can proceed and real frontend code can be written.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Increase the proportion of valid implementable HTML mockup artifacts produced by the design generator from 0% to 100%.
requirements: R1: The design generator must use a model configuration (e.g., changing from a pure image generator to a text/code generation model) that produces implementable HTML code.
R2: The generated output artifact must explicitly contain 'mockup.html' to allow the frontend implementation session to proceed.

slices.title: Update AI Model Target for HTML Design Generation
slices.jtbd: When implementing the generator configuration fix for this epic, I want the requested model to output HTML code rather than an image, so that a valid mockup.html is saved into the design directory.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the design generation script or configuration
When the design generator is executed
Then it requests an HTML payload from an appropriate model rather than gemini-3.1-flash-image.
Given a completed generation run
When examining the output directory
Then a valid mockup.html file is present and not just metadata or image artifacts.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Decrease the rate of design generation producing non-HTML artifacts from 100% to 0%.
